key_highlights: Wall Street retreats into correction as tech and AI equities sell off, setting up the ASX 200 for opening losses.
Australian materials sector demonstrates resilience, with mining majors and small-cap resource explorers defying broader declines.
Treasurer Jim Chalmers signals public service expenditure cuts in the upcoming mid-year budget update (MYEFO).
Macroeconomic headwinds intensify amid rising recession debate, pressure on the AUD, and persistent housing affordability strains.

sectors.trend: Severe global tech and AI selloff spreading to domestic high-beta growth stocks.
sectors.implications: ASX technology constituents (WTC.AX, XRO.AX, NXT.AX) face immediate multiple compression following Wall Street correction.

sectors.trend: Resource sector outperforming broader market; strong drilling results in copper, gold, manganese, and rare earths.
sectors.implications: Mining majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) and explorers offer defensive shelter, though ongoing Chinese property downturn caps bulk upside.

sectors.trend: Mounting scrutiny over mortgage serviceability buffers, regulatory misconduct probes, and subdued credit growth.
sectors.implications: Major banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX) face net interest margin headwinds and calls for APRA serviceability buffer relaxation.

sectors.trend: Long-term gas supply deficits collide with escalating power demand from projected AI data centre deployments.
sectors.implications: Structural tightness supports upstream producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) but raises policy risks around domestic gas reservation.

sectors.trend: Demographic cross-subsidisation tensions in private health insurance alongside selective oncology pipeline developments.
sectors.implications: Private health insurers (MPL.AX) face regulatory headwinds, while targeted biotech clinical assets attract selective interest.

key_themes: Global AI equity valuation de-rating spilling into domestic equity sentiment
Miners and critical minerals acting as defensive shock absorbers
Domestic fiscal consolidation (MYEFO) against rising recession rhetoric
Structural housing affordability stress and calls for APRA macroprudential reform

risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate out of high-PE domestic tech into cash-generative resource majors and defensive yield.
Underweight cyclical consumer discretionary; prioritise non-discretionary retail and high-grade fixed income.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Chinese Real Estate Contraction Impacting Bulks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge iron ore exposure with precious metals (gold) and base metals (copper).

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage Credit Stress and APRA Buffer Inflexibility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit bank portfolio concentration; favor diversified asset managers over mono-line mortgage lenders.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate large-cap diversified resource majors on broader market dips
opportunities.rationale: Mining majors provide strong balance sheets, high dividend yields, and relative resilience during global equity corrections.

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain tactical allocation to gold producers and near-term developers
opportunities.rationale: Safe haven dynamics and steady operational milestones support outperformance during risk-off market regimes.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to high-multiple tech and AI-adjacent domestic equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Ongoing valuation multiple contraction across global tech poses severe downside risks to local high-PE growth stocks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: De-risk retail banking exposure pending APRA macroprudential clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: High housing debt, slowing credit growth, and elevated mortgage serviceability hurdles threaten retail lending margins.

market_outlook.short_term: The ASX 200 is poised to test lower support around 8,150–8,200 as global tech de-risking pressures sentiment, tempered by resilient materials.
market_outlook.long_term: Medium-term recovery to 8,500 hinges on RBA rate cut timing, fiscal discipline in MYEFO, and Chinese demand stabilisation.
key_catalysts: Mid-Year Economic and Fiscal Outlook (MYEFO) expenditure cuts
RBA monetary policy decisions and monthly CPI inflation prints
Wall Street tech valuation stabilisation post-correction
China property sector policy interventions and iron ore price dynamics
watch_list: Iron ore (62% Fe CFR Qingdao) and base metal prices
ASX 200 SPI futures tracking overnight Wall Street sentiment
